channels.raw_text:
Thank you, Satya, and good afternoon, everyone. Our results exceeded expectations across revenue, operating income, and earnings per share. Driven by strong demand across the Microsoft cloud. This quarter, revenue was $92.3 billion, up 19%. Gross margin dollars increased 17% and gross margin percentage was 68%. Operating income increased 21% and 22% in constant currency.

Earnings per share was $4.89, an increase of 18% and 19% in constant currency when adjusted for the impact for our investment in OpenAI.

NFX was roughly in line with guidance. Operating expenses increased 6% driven by continued investments in R&D compute capacity and talent.

Operating margins increased slightly year over year to 50% driven by strong strong revenue growth platform efficiency gains and focused investments across across our portfolio.

Partially offset by sales mix shift to Azure. When adjusted for the the impact for our investments in OpenAI

Earnings per share was $4.89, an increase of 18% and 19% in constant currency when adjusted for the impact for our investment in OpenAI.

NFX was roughly in line with guidance. Operating expenses increased 6% driven by continued investments in R&D compute capacity and talent.

Operating margins increased slightly year over year to 50% driven by strong strong revenue growth platform efficiency gains and focused investments across across our portfolio.

Partially offset by sales mix shift to Azure. When adjusted for the the impact for our investments in OpenAI

extraction_scope.selection: latest explicit period and core financial metrics

limitations: Heard/read numbers are input claims, never filing evidence.
Audio timestamps describe ASR turns, not individual words; speaker labels are not names or roles.
Video samples three frames at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of duration; unsampled visuals can be missed.
Audio and frame claims are checked independently; no cross-modal identity or truth inference.
PDF uses native page text only; reading order/table fidelity is not guaranteed, scanned pages are not checked, and context is not propagated across pages.
User-supplied ticker hint MSFT is not issuer authentication. Extraction selects at most 4 claims per window; unselected content remains unchecked.

verification_policy.scope: evidence eligibility; not a historical model or archived SEC snapshot
